parent_risk_model: V6 selected CatBoost FULL_PROTECTIVE_LOSS probability model
purpose: Separate loss-identification quality from annual risk-score scale drift by ranking each current risk score only against earlier candidate risk scores.

causal_rank.scope: global across the frozen five primary sleeves
causal_rank.same_decision_rule: All candidates sharing one decision_time are scored against history ending before that decision. Current scores are appended only after every candidate at that decision has been ranked.
causal_rank.history_contains: Risk model probabilities for prior primary-gated candidates, including candidates later pruned.
causal_rank.2024_initial_history: Frozen concatenated 2023 purged OOF full-loss probability predictions.
causal_rank.2025_initial_history: Trailing selected-window primary candidate risk probabilities from 2024.
causal_rank.2026_initial_history: Trailing selected-window primary candidate risk probabilities from 2025.

selection_order: higher minimum of Strong PF and Extreme PF
